shortDescription.default: Report and review data protection breaches in SharePoint.

longDescription.default: A GOV.UK-styled form for staff to report data protection breaches, with a report viewer for the data breach team to review cases, request more information, record panel recommendations and close cases. Reports are stored in a SharePoint list with item-level permissions; email notifications and permission-restricted writes go through Azure API Management and Logic Apps.

features.title: Data Breach Form Feature
features.description: Activates the Data Breach Form and Data Breach Report Viewer web parts.
